description: This file defines a React functional component 'NotificationBell' that displays a notifications icon with a dropdown menu. It fetches notifications from an API, displays unread counts, and allows users to mark notifications as read or view all notifications. It uses hooks like useState and useEffect, interacts with external API functions, and dynamically renders UI elements based on notification data.

methods.name: fetchNotifications
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches notifications and updates the component state.

methods.name: handleMarkRead
methods.description: Marks an individual notification as read and refetches notifications.

methods.name: handleMarkAllRead
methods.description: Marks all notifications as read and refetches notifications.

methods.name: getNotificationIcon
methods.description: Returns an emoji icon based on the notification type.

methods.name: getNotificationColor
methods.description: Returns CSS classes for notification background and border colors based on type.
